units.source_text: 柏木的妹妹弘徽殿女御自不必说，夕雾夫人云居雁也非常悲伤。

en.t: Needless to say, Kashiwagi's younger sister, the Kokiden Consort, was deeply saddened, and so was Yugiri's wife, Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 柏木为人诚恳周到，颇有忠厚长者之风，

en.t: Kashiwagi was sincere and considerate by nature, with much of the air of a loyal and kindly elder.

units.source_text: 因此髭黑右大臣的夫人玉鬘对这个异母长兄也特别亲睦，

en.t: For that reason, Tamakazura, the wife of the Minister of the Right Higekuro, was especially close and affectionate toward this elder half-brother.

units.source_text: 她十分关怀柏木的病，自己另请僧众，替他举行祈祷。

en.t: She was deeply concerned about Kashiwagi's illness and personally invited another group of monks to offer prayers for him.

units.source_text: 然而祈祷不是“愈病药”，毕竟徒劳无益。

en.t: Yet prayers are not medicine that cures illness, and in the end they were futile and of no avail.

units.source_text: 柏木终于不及与落叶公主见面，像水泡一般消逝了。

en.t: In the end, Kashiwagi passed away like a bubble on the water, without ever managing to see Princess Ochiba.
